name: floating-dock
title: Floating Dock
blurb: Floating dock with desktop magnification and mobile expanding menu.
description: Responsive dock showing different layouts on desktop (magnifying hover) vs. mobile (expanding menu). Items have title, icon, and href.
use_when: Multi-device apps with floating action menus that adapt to screen size.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces using desktop layout; magnification doesn't work on touch.
a11y: Dock items are keyboard-navigable links. Icons have aria-label or sr-only text. Mobile menu managed with aria-expanded.

props.name: items
props.type: { title: string; icon: React.ReactNode; href: string }[]
